issue_context.title: Add metadata log context and log files
issue_context.body:
##### Enabler description

Add [metadata log](https://github.com/netdata/docs/blob/master/architecture/agent/db/database-log-format-pros-cons.md) threads, implement log file logic in append only manner.

No clean-up or log replay possible at this point. The needed data structures in the agent that would allow those operations don't exist yet.

Introduce the backwards compatible extensions to the `plugins.D` language, but only for flushing. No code will be added to the parsing code in `plugins_d.c`. This is the same situation as what streaming does with`rrdpush.c`. Parsing always goes to `plugins_d.c` but flushing is handled by the context of the producer.

- The metadata log files are next to the dbengine instance datafiles/journalfiles.
- The metadata log depends on the corresponding instance having been set-up beforehand.

- At all host/chart/dimension creation update points in the code write the plugins.D command lines to the metadata log files.

###### Acceptance criteria

* Check approval.
* A logfile that shows metadata operations in the new plugins.d protocol.

The lock in L39 below guards against the read accesses to the host for the sprintf but not this or L36.

This code has been taken from streaming. The host lock primarily protects the list of charts. Moreover, it has been use to protect the list of labels when labels were added and in some cases to protect some writeable fields in the host structure.

However, most of those things are not 100% safe as we proved when we crashed the agent. The immutable values however are never protected in the current locking scheme. One thing that never changes is exactly what is in L36 which is `host->rrdeng_ctx->metalog_ctx`.

This is a way too big discussion to have but I would argue that protecting L36 and many more like it does not give any protection with the way things are currently.
